description: High-quality firms with strong profitability and low leverage exhibit more persistent momentum because their earnings streams are more predictable and less prone to reversal, so combining quality screens with intermediate-term momentum should outperform generic momentum; falsified if forward Sharpe is not higher than the best existing 126d-skip-21 momentum strategy (currently -3.26).
title: Quality Momentum · 126d skip 21 · Top 500 · Long Only
